sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Costco’s durable membership model and strong capital efficiency, reflected by a return on equity of [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]], support a neutral stance. While the low‑leverage profile and robust free cash flow provide a margin of safety, the elevated price‑earnings multiple suggests limited upside at current valuations. Accordingly, the recommendation is Hold.

insight.text: A debt‑to‑equity ratio of [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]] underscores financial flexibility.
